monthly_counts_scope: All valid saved transfer events before display truncation; fee-only/failed/unconfirmed/non-transfer rows excluded by the exporter. Source coverage limits still apply.

monthly_counts_units.priced_*_usd: usd at each transfer time; known subtotal

truncation.rule: Display sample: half newest transfers, then key checkpoint examples and largest priced non-dust transfers, prioritizing designation-window events. All designation/delisting/issuer events retained. Window transfers can be sampled for byte/count limits. Full monthly counts and source timelines cover omitted transfers.

usd_display_precision: 6 decimal places; tiny positive values retain 8 significant figures; source prices and quantities remain in saved evidence
